title: Bernoulli sum tail bound
statement: Let $p$ be a nonnegative real number with $p\le 1$, and let $k>0$. On the product distribution of $k$ independent Bernoulli-$p$ bits, suppose $Y_1,\ldots,Y_k$ are independent random variables, each with sub-Gaussian moment-generating-function parameter $(1/2)^2$. For every $t\ge 0$, the probability that $\sum_{i=1}^k Y_i\ge tk$ is at most $\exp(-2t^2k)$.
hypotheses_covered: The random variables $Y_i$ are independent under the product Bernoulli-$p$ measure
